name: com.inburgeringtest/inburgering-practice
title: InburgeringTest — Dutch Inburgeringsexamen Practice & Grader
description: Browse Dutch Inburgeringsexamen A2, B1, and KNM modules and grade free practice answers.

tools.name: list_inburgering_exam_modules
tools.description: Return Dutch Inburgeringsexamen (A2, B1 / NT2 Programma I) module specifications, the 8 official KNM syllabus themes, free-preview exam set metadata, and optional free sample practice questions (without answer keys) ready for learner practice.

section.description: Filter by exam module ('all', 'knm', 'lezen', 'luisteren', 'schrijven', 'spreken', or 'diagnostic'). Defaults to 'all'.

theme.description: Optional KNM syllabus theme slug to filter sample KNM questions.

includeSampleQuestions.description: Include free-preview practice questions without answer keys (default: true).

limit.description: Maximum number of free-preview sample questions to return (1 to 8, default: 4).

tools.name: evaluate_inburgering_answers
tools.description: Deterministically grade multiple-choice answers against a free-preview Dutch Inburgeringsexamen set (KNM, Lezen A2, Luisteren A2, or A2 vs B1 Diagnostic). Returns overall and answered accuracy, pass/fail status, A2/B1 track recommendation (for diagnostic), per-theme breakdown, weak themes, and Dutch/English explanations for submitted answers.

examSetId.description: Free-preview exam set ID to grade (knm-free-1, lezen-a2-free-1, luisteren-a2-free-1, diagnostic-a2-b1).

answers.description: Map of questionId to selected option letter ("a", "b", "c", or "d"), e.g. {"knm-werk-1": "a"}.
